purpose: Development crosswalk showing where Course 3 environmental, lighting, sensor-verification and record objectives can be observed in Practical A. Mapping coverage does not constitute practical validation, evaluator calibration, inter-rater evidence, standard setting or release approval.

objectiveMappings.statement: Read and record routine temperature, relative humidity and VPD information with correct units, location, time and sensor context while keeping facility targets separate from observed values.
practicalTasks: Read environmental values and distinguish a normal reading, a questionable sensor reading and a condition requiring follow-up.
Complete the crop-inspection record and shift handoff.

objectiveMappings.statement: Read and document photoperiod, PPFD and basic canopy light-map information using consistent measurement position and orientation without treating one point as representative of an entire canopy.
practicalTasks: When assigned, perform a repeatable canopy light verification using the supplied grid, measurement height and sensor orientation; preserve all PPFD points instead of substituting one reading for the canopy.

Record supplied photoperiod information and the PPFD verification with units, location, time, instrument/context and any unresolved spatial difference; compare against the supplied scenario target or limit without independently redesigning lighting strategy.
expectedEvidence: completed canopy light-verification grid or simulated measurement record
PPFD units, measurement location/height/orientation and instrument/context
photoperiod record and comparison with the supplied scenario target or limit
deliverables: canopy light-verification grid or supplied simulation record

objectiveMappings.statement: Evaluate whether an environmental reading is representative, suspect or incomplete by checking sensor placement, agreement, calibration status, logging context and crop location.
practicalTasks: Read environmental values and distinguish a normal reading, a questionable sensor reading and a condition requiring follow-up.

Use the supplied sensor placement, comparison readings, calibration/verification status, logging context and crop location to judge whether a selected reading is representative, suspect or incomplete.
expectedEvidence: sensor representativeness decision using placement, comparison, verification/calibration and logging context

objectiveMappings.statement: Perform permitted operator-level sensor and environmental-equipment readiness checks and escalate faults, alarms or conditions that require unauthorized repair or control redesign.
practicalTasks: Perform only the supplied operator-level sensor/equipment readiness checks and escalate any fault, alarm or condition that would require unauthorized repair, calibration or control redesign.
expectedEvidence: operator-level readiness check and escalation decision where applicable

objectiveMappings.statement: Create reconstructable environmental and light records that distinguish target, measured value, alarm, verification action, unresolved condition and escalation status.
practicalTasks: Record supplied photoperiod information and the PPFD verification with units, location, time, instrument/context and any unresolved spatial difference; compare against the supplied scenario target or limit without independently redesigning lighting strategy.
Complete the crop-inspection record and shift handoff.
expectedEvidence: photoperiod record and comparison with the supplied scenario target or limit
deliverables: canopy light-verification grid or supplied simulation record
